openNote: Entries waiting on the OKX order book.
algoNote: Stops and take-profits wait on OKX’s servers, so they work even when your Mac sleeps.
externalTip: Placed outside Atlas, for example in the OKX app. Atlas imported it during reconciliation.
readOnlyTip: Algo orders can’t be cancelled here. Cancel the entry order instead, and its stop and targets go with it.

sheet.atlas: Atlas won’t place it again. If part of it has filled, that part keeps a stop sized to what filled.
sheet.external: This order was placed outside Atlas. Cancelling it here cancels it on OKX too.
sheet.failGeneric: Atlas couldn’t cancel the order. Try again in a moment.

empty.title: No open orders
empty.body: Atlas places orders only after you approve a trade.

algoEmpty.title: No algo orders
algoEmpty.body: Stops and take-profits appear here once a position is open.

filteredEmptyOpen: No open orders on {{inst}}. A filled order moves to History.
filteredEmptyAlgo: No stop-loss or take-profit orders on {{inst}}.

error.title: Couldn’t load your orders
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
